definitions.explanation: A place where fees are collected for using a toll road or bridge.

examples.japanese: {料金所|りょうきんじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: I pay at the toll booth.

examples.japanese: {料金所|りょうきんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧。
ETC⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{料金所|りょうきんじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}まらなくて→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: If you have ETC, you don't have to stop at the toll booth.

notes:
{料金所|りょうきんじょ} is found at entrances and exits of toll roads.

FORMS:
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (fee, charge) + {所|じょ} (place)

- ⟦{通行料|つうこうりょう}→通行料：14849_tsuukouryou⟧: toll, passage fee
